name: Survey tile in Aquarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.4 degrees south of the ecliptic in Aquarius, imaged by SPHEREx 19 times in 5 visits over 38 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 38 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 38 hours starting 2025-05-23, at wavelengths from 0.77 to 4.24 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
